prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset: ONE compact audio cassette reel hub, isolated reusable animation part.
Photorealistic ivory/off-white plastic annular reel hub photographed in a perfectly orthographic 90-degree overhead view. Mathematical circular concentric outer and inner rings, exactly centered at canvas center. A flat shallow washer-like face with SIX evenly spaced SHORT inward rectangular drive teeth around the circular center opening. It is a thin flat cassette spool hub, NOT a deep cup, NOT a cone, NOT a wheel tilted toward camera. All teeth identical width and length, all on one plane. No visible vertical side face or elliptical hole. Minimal symmetrical bevel, clean matte polymer surface with subtle fine real material grain. No deep well, no exaggerated inner sidewalls, no asymmetric extrusion or crescent below the ring.
Square 1024x1024 canvas. Outer hub diameter approx 800px, center at (512,512). Inner circular opening approx 510px diameter with short inward teeth extending about35px inward. Neutral even diffuse illumination over central drive face so it can rotate without a traveling bright specular spot. Subtle upper-left highlight ONLY on the narrow outermost bevel; no black directional shadow painted across the center. Center opening is uniformly dark charcoal black with no spindle, no cap, no mottled glossy reflection. Transparent outer background with actual alpha if possible; no checkerboard. No cassette, no tape winding, no paper, no text, no logo. Material is warm off-white matching realistic cassette plastic, no chrome, no snow-white flat cartoon outlines.
notes: Generated hub silhouette was not selected: visible sidewall and perspective persisted. Only flat polymer material patch (520,150,90,60) is sampled in SVG. Hub structure is a concentric native SVG face with a rotating 6-tooth mask; surface grain, bevel light and outer ring stay in fixed cassette coordinates.
